# Courtyard Residence — illustration reference

Design revision: 2.0.0 · schema containers-hamlet-design/v2.0 · design hash 76904ecf

This description is generated from the canonical design model. The reference SVG is the authoritative geometric reference. The illustration prompt is an interpretation.

## Architectural facts
- 1 occupied storey
- 2 container modules (40ft, 40ft)
- flat roof at 0 degrees
- 63.3 m2 gross floor area
- 63.3 m2 ground coverage
- 3.8 m to the roof

## Modules
- **m1** — storey 1, 12.192 × 2.438 m, base 0.6 m, rotation 0°, timber cladding.
- **m2** — storey 1, 12.192 × 2.438 m, base 0.6 m, rotation 90°, timber cladding.

## Openings
- m1 / Courtyard doors — north sliding-door, 2.6 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m1 / Dining window — north window, 1.4 × 1.4 m, sill 0.8 m.
- m1 / Bedroom window — south window, 1.4 × 1.3 m, sill 0.9 m.
- m1 / Bathroom window — south window, 0.8 × 1 m, sill 1.4 m.
- m1 / Entry door — east door, 0.95 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m1 / Garden window — west window, 1.2 × 1.4 m, sill 0.8 m.
- m2 / Kitchen window — north window, 1.2 × 1.2 m, sill 1.1 m.

- m2 / Studio doors — north sliding-door, 2 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m2 / Workspace window — south window, 1.2 × 1.3 m, sill 0.9 m.
- m2 / Garden window — south window, 1.4 × 1.3 m, sill 0.9 m.

## Rooms and zones
- m1 / Sleeping — sleeping, 0–3.8 m. Ground-floor bedroom.
- m1 / Bathroom — bathroom, 3.8–6 m. Adaptable bathroom target.
- m1 / Dining — dining, 6–8.6 m. Courtyard doors; step-free.
- m1 / Living — living, 8.6–12 m. Partial wall opening to the courtyard; framing review required.
- m2 / Kitchen — kitchen, 0–3.4 m. Kitchen with a courtyard window.
- m2 / Workspace — work, 3.4–7.4 m. Flexible workspace or accessible bedroom.
- m2 / Storage — storage, 7.4–9.4 m. Storage.
- m2 / Circulation — circulation, 9.4–12 m. Covered link to the courtyard and main module.

## Outdoor spaces
- p1: 6.4 × 2.8 m covered porch on the north face of m1.
- d1: deck beyond p1, 1.4 m.
- c1: glazed  connection between m1 and m2.

## Site and camera
- Assigned site: Cabin C (site rotation 82°).
- Principal view: A long view west between pine trunks to a narrow strip of lake, more water than sky.
- Path approach: east
- Camera: exterior three-quarter view, 1.6 m, 35 mm, bearing 297°.
